name: Flowering Blossom Rod

Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Druidcraft at will, Overgrowth and Insect Plague once a day each, and it mends plants.
text: While holding this rod you can cast Druidcraft at will and, once per dawn, Plant Growth (its Overgrowth only). As a Magic action you can restore the ordinary plants in a 5-foot cube you can see within 15 feet to full health for 1d4 days. Once per dawn you can also cast Insect Plague from it, using your spell save DC.

powers.name: Overgrowth
powers.text: Once a day: Plant Growth's Overgrowth.

params.text: brings the ordinary plants in a 5-foot cube back to health for a few days
